# Pre-market brief: Tue 2026-11-17 (as of ~8:15 AM ET)

1. **NVDA earnings AMC: the AI-trade test.** It's the first report since Huang resigned (interim CEO Kress), and the stock has lost ~$410B in value since he left. NVDA reportedly told customers it will stop selling to data-center operators that rent >50% of their GPUs to Chinese firms. It also cut its INTC stake 25%, so INTC is ~-3% pre. CRWV is -2% pre ([Investing/Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-nvidia-red-cat-fall-home-depot-spacex-gains-5032425), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-tuesday-november-17-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-earnings-091546152.html)). The semi/AI-hardware avoid holds through the print.
2. **Futures mixed** as of 12:25 GMT: Dow -0.33%, S&P +0.16%, NDX +0.57%. The 10-yr is ~5.121% (-2bp) and the 2-yr ~4.821%. Brent is $92.74 and WTI $86.09; the IEA sees a Q4 surplus ([Sharecast](https://www.sharecast.com/news/market-report-us-pre-open/wall-street-nyse-dow-jones-nasdaq-stocks-equities--24201928.html)).
3. **BTC ~$64-65k** after dipping below $62k at the weekend. Fear & Greed is ~13, and traders link the weakness to Anthropic's IPO (prices 11/18, trades 11/19) ([X](https://x.com/i/trending/2122662776690848160)). The crypto avoids stay.
4. **DIS +~2% pre.** FQ4 adj EPS was $1.77 vs $1.68 and revenue $25.9B vs $25.2B. The dividend goes up 33% to $2, and Disney reiterated double-digit FY27 EPS growth ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/disney-q4-earnings-beat-estimates-as-parks-and-streaming-keep-growing-113817189.html), [BNN/Reuters](https://www.bnnbloomberg.ca/business/company-news/2026/11/17/disney-beats-earnings-forecasts-plans-to-increase-content-spending/)).
5. **HD -1-2% pre.** EPS was $3.86 vs $3.84, revenue $43.4B vs $42.8B, and comps +2.2%. FY sales guidance moved to the top end (~4.5%). CFO McPhail becomes CEO on 11/23 ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/17/home-depot-hd-q3-earnings-2026.html), [Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/home-depot-names-finance-chief-mcphail-as-ceo-5032246)).
6. **ACM +7-8% pre (~$78)** on its Q4 beat and record backlog ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/earnings/26/11/63332278/aecom-hikes-dividend-backlog-hits-record-28-billion), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ACM/)). JD is -3.4% after missing on revenue and profit ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-nvidia-red-cat-fall-home-depot-spacex-gains-5032425)).

**Today:** October retail sales and import prices at 8:30, IP at 9:15, NAHB at 10:00 ([Sharecast](https://www.sharecast.com/news/market-report-us-pre-open/wall-street-nyse-dow-jones-nasdaq-stocks-equities--24201928.html)). **This week:** FOMC minutes Wed 2 PM, then TGT/LOW/TJX Wed BMO, PANW Wed AMC, WMT Thu BMO, and the Anthropic IPO Thu.

**Swing ideas** (session after a -1.9% S&P day, so these are small and conditional):
- **DIS**: non-tech beat, 33% dividend hike, and a reiterated double-digit EPS guide. The pre-market gap is under 5%. Log at the close only if it holds green. Confidence: low. Risk: 53rd-week flattery, $26B content-spend step-up, NVDA-driven tape.
- **ACM** (CONDITIONAL, carried over): the gap is >5%, so log at the close only if the gain holds. Confidence: low. Risk: revenue miss, GAAP guide below consensus.
